## Common layout traits

- Full-bleed plan viewport (little or no formal CAD title block)
- Grey base linework + high-contrast red stake markers/labels
- Multi-line labels: point # / elevation / description (offsets, BOC, HYD, …)
- North arrow + `SCALE: 1" = X'` with sheet-size callout `(W"×H")`
- Legend/title cluster usually bottom-right, bottom-left, or top-left
